title: Which execution venues an asset manager's wealth board keeps off its platform's venue list when the group's central dealing desk starts dealing for the platform, on each venue's adverse move in the minute after a fill
subdomain: market-microstructure-execution-cost (an asset manager's venue list for its wealth platform's in-house dealing orders, each venue's adverse move in the minute after a fill read from a year of the central desk's algorithmic fills)
prompt_shape: a scorecard of eight venues against the policy's 1.5 basis point line with each venue's adverse move in whole basis points and a chart, and two tables (the mean size against average daily volume of the platform's 2026 dealt orders as 2027 market orders at each dealing point; the value bought less the value sold through Gresmere in each month to October)
